+12V.reference: TPS552892-Q1 (SLVSGT7 6.3): COUT 10-1000 uF effective, 100 uF nominal; TI example 4 x 22u. S9.0: 6 x 22u at VOUT before R109 + 2 at the headers

-12V.reference: LMR38020 Table 9-1 is a BUCK guide in rated C (12 V/1 MHz 2 x 10u, 12 V/400 kHz 1 x 22u); IBB: no TI table; max ~10 x design or 1000 uF incl. the rack

VIN.reference: TPS552892-Q1: CIN >= 4.7 uF effective (TI example ~20 uF) + 0.1 uF at VIN: C6, C7, C77, C78 + C8; LMR38020 CIN >= 4.7 uF effective (C25 + C26 VIN to -12V, unchanged) and C24. Bias band 20 V (covers 16.5 V and the later 20 V retarget)

damper.reference: series-R damper branch, capacitor study option B_RCx2

+12V.note: TPS552892-Q1; 10.55 V = converter input at the U5 turn-off minimum, 21 V = the later 20 V retarget. Step: 1 A load step against the low-C bank at the ~10 kHz crossover screen

-12V.note: IBB at the S9.0 converter inputs (15 V nominal: D = 0.444): the output bank carries the full load during the on time; per-part rms <= 2 x share of cout_rms (imbalance x2) -> well below 1206 heating limits

vin_damper.VIN_ceramics: 5 x 10u/50V 1206 (12.5-33.0 uF effective at the 20 V bias band)
vin_damper.load: 45 W constant power at 12.5 V (upper estimate, linearised)

R92_stress.note: 1.5 V VIN dip assumed for the step energy; 1206 250 mW part

rail_release.note: N cycles of unchanged converter current, then -Vo/L (no loop model, no sink). +12V: TPS552892-Q1 at the lowest fSW corner and the setpoint maximum; the R109-limit row releases an overload (sensitivity)

+12V.allowance_basis: S9.1 restricted to 0.44mF external, within the complex-loop impedance envelope; startup on 3A source remains a qualification test, not proven by CC alone
+12V.hiccup: only if VOUT < 0.8 V with the average inductor limit for 2 ms after tSS: a short circuit, not a capacitive start (R109 holds IL near IOUT)

-12V.allowance_basis: min(hiccup model, TI output-capacitance guidance minus the rated onboard bank)
-12V.ti_limit: <= ~10 x design COUT or 1000 uF, whichever is smaller (SNVSC40E 9.2.2.5)

soft_start.rack_reference: Typical Eurorack module: 10-47 uF per rail; 20 modules x 22 uF = 0.44 mF per rail. S9.0: +12V charges through the R109 constant-current loop; -12V per the LMR38020 hiccup rule
soft_start.note: Allowances are rack capacitance on top of the onboard bank (high corner). Loads that draw less than the full rating during start-up leave more room. Bench item: start-up into the real rack at 13.5 V.

+12V.converter_OVP_note: TPS552892-Q1 VOVP is absolute (22.5-24.5 V), not relative to the 12 V setpoint: it is not a 12 V protection; the U20 guard is

sensitivity_release_from_R109_limit_max.note: an overload at the R109 limit being released (N=16, low C): a negative margin means a possible nuisance latch-off (fail-safe), not a hazard

response_us.total_after_crossing: ~3 us + RC; then U5 off, rails decay

ov_guard.note: The bands are threshold screens, not a peak-voltage guarantee: opening U5 does not stop the energy already stored behind it. A false trip latches every rail off (MAIN off, press RESET). Common-mode: both comparator inputs sit at ~1.24 V at a positive trip, inside VPD-2 V at full temperature; -12V compares near 0 V.

ov_reference.earliest_rail_rise_ms: > 12 (TPS3808 open-CT POR minimum) + U5 ramp + converter soft start
ov_reference.stability: TLV431 is stable without a capacitor; 10u X5R (~9 uF at 1.24 V) is right of the oscillation region (~3 nF..1 uF at VKA = VREF, SLVS139Z Fig. 5-18; Fig. 5-19 phase margin ~25-40 deg at 0.4-1.5 mA)

S8_without_clamp.note: S8: R98 7.5k to V3V3, R99 47k to -12V, no clamp

ov_clamp.note: BAT54SL VF <= 0.24 V at 0.1 mA is a 25 C limit only: U20 pin 9 stays above -0.3 V at room temperature; cold (VF ~+2 mV/C) or at -16 V it can go below -0.3 V (not a guaranteed clamp). Since S8.3 U20 runs from VPD, so it MAY be powered in this state (S8.4 review M3, see v3v3_loss): the protection argument is that R99 limits the node current to <= 0.15 mA (LM2901B abs max -50 mA into an input) and that an incorrect U20 output cannot enable anything while V3V3 is gone (R64 holds RUN low). In normal operation the diode is reverse biased by 0.14 V and by ~0 V at the trip point, so its leakage does not move the threshold.

comparator_supply.supply: VPD before U5, after F1; D1 transient clamp
comparator_supply.note: Positive headroom during qualified operation. D1 rated clamp is NOT a measured ringing bound. Verify VPD spikes <36V at both comparator ICs; V3V3-loss states are in v3v3_loss; cold negative-input clamp and replug remain bench gates.

states.U20 powered (VPD up, V3V3 lost or not ye: positive channels: REF_OV ~0 V, taps >= 0 V, output state undefined/low; -12V channel: MON_OVN negative if the rack holds -12V, D22 clamps
states.U20 unpowered (VPD gone): inputs see the same divider; only the bounded input current matters
states.logic: U10-U15 unpowered, all pull-ups (R97 OV_N, R35/R62 status, R63 MAIN_OK) go to the dead V3V3; R64 holds RUN low -> U5 SHDN low, U2 EN (MAIN_OK) low, U4 follows +12V: nothing can be enabled by any comparator output

v3v3_loss.LM2901B_input_abs_max: -0.3 V; input current -50 mA max (SLCS006Z 6.1); footnote: current through the parasitic input diode can make the output incorrect, normal operation resumes after
v3v3_loss.common_mode: inputs 0..VPD-2 V while VPD >= 15 V except MON_OVN (-0.24 V at 25 C, ~-0.37 V cold screen)
v3v3_loss.D1: SMBJ22A on VPD does not conduct in these states (stand-off 22 V); its 35.5 V rated clamp leaves 0.5 V to the LM2901B 36 V recommended maximum (38 V abs max): VPD ringing at U18/U20 is a bench gate
v3v3_loss.replug: see replug_por (S8.5): the S8.4 ~1 ms replug margin ignored the R98 load on REF_OV and is withdrawn
v3v3_loss.verdict: No enable path exists while V3V3 is gone; the input current is bounded far below the abs-max. The D22 clamp is NOT a guaranteed -0.3 V clamp when cold. Replug into a rack holding -12V: OPEN item (replug_por), not a margin.

minus12_startup.rule: hiccup only if |Vout| < 40 % (4.80 V) with ILS limiting for 256 cycles after TOCP_BLK
minus12_startup.vin_floor_basis: converter VIN at the U5 turn-on minimum (VPD 12.26 V) minus the 1.00 V D10 + U5 drop: the converters cannot start below it
minus12_startup.vin_sag_basis: converter VIN at the U5 turn-off minimum (VPD 11.37 V): a source sagging during start-up can hold the converters this low

input_path.basis: R2 senses VPD before D10; converter VIN = VPD - D10 (0.75 V S5 screen at 5 A) - U5 RON max (53 mOhm, S5) x its 4.698 A high-corner current limit (input_budget U5_limit_screen_A): no steady input current can exceed the actual U5 limit, so this is a conservative drop, not a typical one. S9.0: unchanged (12.5 V converter input at the 13.5 V rated minimum)

minus12_startup.hiccup_model_basis: VIN11.26_I0.8A_blank9ms: converter VIN at the U5 turn-on minimum, the published 0.8 A from 0 V, half the typical-only 18 ms blanking (TI gives no minimum)

TI_COUT_guidance.text: limit total output capacitance to ~10 x the design value or 1000 uF, whichever is smaller (SNVSC40E 9.2.2.5); beyond it start-up at full load and loop stability need a dedicated study

minus12_startup.published_basis: min(hiccup model, TI output-capacitance guidance minus the rated onboard bank)
minus12_startup.window_check: time to full 12 V at the allowance stays far below the 309 ms startup-window minimum
minus12_startup.note: Analytic screen, not a guarantee: TOCP_BLK has no specified minimum and the hiccup restart behaviour is not specified. The rack capacitance sits behind cables, but TI's total-COUT guidance is applied anyway. Bench gate: start into the real rack at the lowest input.

S8_TPS62933F_at_15V.verdict: out of regulation: needs VPD >= 14.42 V at 2.5 A and the setpoint maximum, above the 14.25 V unloaded minimum of a compliant 15 V source; it fails even at 0 A (1.033 > 0.98), so neither a lower +12V current nor a higher minimum input inside the USB PD tolerance can fix it

plus12_buckboost.loss_model: conduction = IL^2 x (RDS HS1 + HS2 + max LS) x 1.5 (hot), switching 2 legs x 0.5 V I x 10 ns x fSW, dead time 2 legs x 2 x 0.7 V x I x 20 ns x fSW, VCC LDO VIN x 10 mA; L1 DCR x 1.3 (hot); assumptions, not TI data: bench thermal gate

frequency_choice.TI_advice: < 500 kHz for high power, or a lower switch current limit above it (SLVSGT7 8.1)
frequency_choice.why: 966kHz retained; R109 is a slow output CC loop, NOT a programmable switch-current limit. Thermal screening now uses 18mR; all transient/beat-tone/thermal gates remain open. Frequency tolerance bands can touch; nominal separation is not a no-beat guarantee

published_envelope.load_type: passive resistive small-signal load; no arbitrary negative-impedance active rack guarantee

compensation.method: TI Eq19-23; exact PI (no crossover shortcut), split bank/R109/cable branch, all listed corner products; one-period delay + fsw/10 pole. GEA +/-30% is sensitivity, not a datasheet limit.
compensation.release_test: Bode at VIN corners, bank/rack corners and 0.05A/rating: PM>45 deg, GM>10 dB, no sustained ringing; no-load FPWM and active rack impedances measured separately. Not performed.

plus12_buckboost.resolution: TPS552892-Q1 four-switch buck-boost (pin-compatible role, new footprint, +10 parts): regulates 12.08 V from 10.55 V (U5 sag) to 21 V (20 V retarget) at the published 2.4 A and at the R109 limit

rating.rule: S9.1: +12V retained 2.4 A with >=0.20 A headroom below the 18mR CC minimum; NOT the superseded 75% rule. -12V retains 75% rounded to nearest0.1A. Thermal qualification still required.

input_path.basis: R2 senses VPD before D10; converter VIN = VPD - D10 (0.75 V S5 screen at 5 A) - U5 RON max (53 mOhm, S5) x its 4.698 A high-corner current limit (input_budget U5_limit_screen_A): no steady input current can exceed the actual U5 limit, so this is a conservative drop, not a typical one. S9.0: unchanged (12.5 V converter input at the 13.5 V rated minimum)

capability_basis.+12V: R109 constant-current minimum 48 mV / (18 mOhm x 1.01 x 1.0075 x 1.002 Kelvin residual)
capability_basis.-12V: LMR38020 (ILS min + ripple/2)(1 - D), SNVSC40E Eq. 7

rating.total_basis: the 15 V / 3.0 A contract at the 13.5 V rated minimum: 40.5 W in, 37.27 W after D10/U5/aux, worst efficiency mix (-12V at its rating first) 33.76 W delivered, rounded DOWN to the watt

below_rated_range.basis: U5 keeps the converters running down to its turn-off minimum (sagging source); the rating is NOT specified there

simultaneous.note: U5 (3.69-4.70 A) does not enforce the 3 A contract: above the published total the source decides (current limit or a PD hard reset; a brown-out after ARMED latches FAULT)

rating.headers: above ~2 A per rail use both J2 and J3 (2 contacts per rail per header, ~1 A IDC contact screen)
rating.note: Prototype rating from datasheet minimum limits and assumed efficiencies, not a measured or thermal-qualified rating.

pd_contract.request: 15 V fixed PDO, CH224A CFG1 = R1 56k (120k = 20 V for the retarget); no current-contract tracking, PG is not a current guarantee
pd_contract.contract_note: 45 W at 15 V is 3.0 A, the fixed-PDO ceiling: no standard source offers more than 3 A at 15 V
pd_contract.range_basis: 13.5 V = 15 V -5 % less the 0.75 V cable/connector allowance at 3 A; 16.5 V = +10 % ceiling (converters and guards rated far above it; S9.2 U5 OVP 17.30-19.44 V)
pd_contract.required_adapter: USB PD source with a 15 V / 3 A fixed PDO, i.e. a >= 45 W PDP adapter (a 27 W source offers only 15 V / 1.8 A and will trip or cycle under load); a non-PD or 5 V-only source never turns U5 on
pd_contract.U5_limit_vs_contract: U5 3.69-4.70 A is above the 3 A contract: it protects the board, it does not enforce the contract; overload beyond the published total is handled by the source

input_qualification.cable: 13.5 V at module = 14.25 V source minimum minus 0.75 V cable at 3 A (0.25 ohm loop)
input_qualification.why: Even perfect resistors cannot meet both recommendations: rising<=13 requires divider factor<=13/1.224=10.621; falling>=11.8 requires >=11.8/1.09=10.826. Actual falling minimum is reported, never relabelled 11.8 V.

enable_logic.logic: U4 enabled iff own VPD AND RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK (derived from the netlist, not assumed)
enable_logic.drive_source: Q1 emitter net VPD (own input upstream of D10); never +12V or VIN
enable_logic.equation: EN_N - V(-12V) = Q1 on ? (VPD - VCEsat - V(-12V))*R18/(R17+R18) : Ileak*R18
enable_logic.off_pullup: R112 ties Q1 base to VPD; R115 100k defines N_EN_RETURN; R18 pulls EN to the U4 ground
enable_logic.method: Structure traced from the design connectivity (LMR38020 EN pin -> divider -> PNP collector -> base pull-ups and series NMOS sink chain -> GND); bounds over VPD 12.26/16.5/19.44 V, resistor tolerance + TCR, NMOS VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V with 1 uA leakage, PNP hFE >= 60, VEB <= 0.35 V off and 5 uA leakage. With a switch open the switches above it are source followers (node <= gate), so the chain current is bounded by the node defaults; a chain node with no DC default is undefined.
enable_logic.supply_loss_response: MAIN_OK has falling deglitch; until it drops a powered converter can sink a bus. Clamp test bounds that finite interval; never parallel a running module.

required_source_capability.basis: published 33 W load (2.4 A / 0.33 A) + 0.44 mF per rail, 14.25 V source + 0.25 ohm, fastest 2.5 ms soft start, R109 icc max; U5 current limit caps the plant at 4.7 A

startup_qualification.strict_3A_outcome: FAULT latched at ARMED after repeated U5 UVLO dropouts (fail-safe, RUN low, input off); NOT a single-attempt start
startup_qualification.meaning: A strictly 3.00 A-limited 15 V source cannot supply the simultaneous soft-start charge of both rails at the published load and rack; the module then fails safe and needs RESET. Real PD sources with overload headroom (peak-current capability, OCP above ~4.7 A for a few ms) are expected to start it: post-prototype acceptance test S1 decides, per source.

matrix.condition: Cold start, 14.25 V source +0.25 ohm cable, exact 3.00 A constant-current limit; 0/0.44 mF external each rail; 0/15/25/33 W load; both delay corners; log all attempts
matrix.pass: Single attempt: both rail monitors good within 250 ms of first enable; ARMED by 0.90 s; no V3V3/POR reset, no source restart, <=3.00 A steady input; no retry hidden from record. A strict-3 A FAIL is recorded as the expected fail-safe (FAULT latched, input off) and restricts the qualified source list, it is not hidden

matrix.condition: Same loads with a PD source hard-resetting on >3 A; include 5 V phase and V3V3 fully collapsed to 0 V
matrix.pass: A single hard reset is counted and disqualifies that source/load combination for guaranteed start; no success by discarding earlier failed attempts

matrix.condition: Persistent rail short, uninterrupted source, then manual RESET and separate full power removal/reapplication
matrix.pass: Each power epoch with input held must fault within 0.90 s+2 ms of first enable, hold RUN low until explicit reset, and fault again with short present

matrix.condition: Ten automatic input hard resets every 200 ms while short remains, V3V3 collapsed in each off interval
matrix.pass: Qualification result must be FAIL_REPEATED_POWER_RESET, never a pass from a final successful cycle; fixture latches power OFF on the second autonomous reset

startup_qualification.power_reset_policy: STARTED and FAULT are volatile. Full V3V3/POR loss legitimately clears both; S8.5 one-shot preserved, not falsely advertised as nonvolatile. Automatic retrying sources are outside qualified envelope. Fixture counts epochs and must stop retries; hardware nonvolatile lockout remains absent.
startup_qualification.bench_status: NOT PERFORMED; post-prototype acceptance tests S1-S4 (TP1 VPD, TP26 VIN, TP19 STARTED, TP10 ARMED, TP9 RUN)

rules.b: VBR min at 0 C > U5 OVP rising maximum (OVP acts first)
rules.c: VC(IPP) <= 42 V / 1.15 (U2 abs max with 15 % ringing margin) and VC + 14.02 V < 50 V (C25/C26)

choice.why_divider: Lowering the OVP from the 20 V-input setting (22.76-25.60 V) to the 15 V input is the cleaner fix: it is a one-resistor change on the protection that is supposed to act first, it also coordinates D1 (SMBJ22A, VBR 24.4 V) for the first time, and it keeps the TVS clamp low. No SMBJ satisfies (b) with the S9.1 divider without failing (c).

pulse_budget.basis: 1 A x VC 32.4 V (rated clamp bounds the 1 A clamp: 24.92 V at 25 C, 27.71 V at Tj 150 C via alphaVBR) x 20 ms = 0.648 J. Capability: 600 W 10/1000 us rating mapped to a 20 ms rectangle with a sqrt(t) thermal impedance (Dawson peak 0.541044) = 87.2 W at 25 C, x0.8 Fig. 2 derating at 50 C = 69.8 W. No universal joule rating or continuous claim; 5 W steady-state rating applies only on an infinite heat sink.

vin_clamp.tested_by: IN-2 (OVP trip/recovery at TP1) and CL-1/T1-D (D24 clamp at TP26/TP27)

thermal_contract.status: CONDITIONAL: valid only if the routed board meets placement.json routing_contract.thermal; confirmed by post-prototype TH-1..TH-3, not by this screen

contract.In1: solid PGND plane (0.5 oz), no slot or cut within 15 mm of the U2 centre (via antipads only)
contract.PGND_vias: >= 10 vias 0.3/0.6 mm with centres <= 4 mm outside the package outline on the PGND copper of the U2 cell: at both PGND land ends where the fan-out leaves room (the bars are on a 0.5 mm pitch: SW1/SW2 leave west, VIN/VOUT east), at C8.2 and C81.2 and on the PGND copper joining them; to In1 and to the B.Cu GND pour; never in a pad
contract.VIN_area: F.Cu VIN pour >= 120 mm2 joining U2 pin 7, C8, C6, C7, C77, C78 and D24 K; >= 6 vias to an In2 VIN area >= 300 mm2
contract.VOUT_area: F.Cu P12_VOUT pour >= 150 mm2 joining U2 pin 11, C81, C11-C14, C79, C80 and R109 pad 1; >= 6 vias to a B.Cu P12_VOUT area >= 200 mm2. D26 K and TP20 (no DC current) join it with >= 1.0 mm copper or >= 2 vias from the B.Cu area, never through +12V copper
contract.B_Cu_GND: B.Cu GND pour >= 600 mm2 under the U2 / L1 / bank region, stitched to In1 with >= 20 vias

R109.basis: TA-I RLM12 derating: 1 W at 70 C to 0 at 155 C (85 C/W) with the 300 mm2 copper of the contract

contract.force_copper: P12_VOUT (pad 1) and +12V (pad 4) F.Cu copper >= 150 mm2 each within 10 mm (>= 300 mm2 together), each with >= 3 vias to a same-net B.Cu or In2 area

contract.copper: VPD (anode) and MAIN_IN (cathode) F.Cu pours >= 400 mm2 each, each with >= 8 vias to a same-net B.Cu area >= 300 mm2

thermal_contract.acceptance: TH-1 U2/R109 case temperature at 2.95 A, TH-2 D10/U5 at 3 A input, TH-3 U4 at 0.8 A; docs/s8-single/routing-notes.md

basic_only_counterfactual.note: Every precision divider at 1 % + 1 % TCR (Basic). Any failing entry is a screen the design no longer passes; hence the documented Extended exception (sourcing.json basic_only_policy).

startup_window.arming: S8.5: one-shot, see arming (TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED; S8.4 RUN AND MAIN_OK was restartable)

required: R1 bounded: ARMED within the U11 delay (0.31-0.88 s) of the first converter enable after RESET, and held until RESET/FAULT: the converters can never run unarmed for longer
R2 no restart: nothing a fault can toggle (MAIN_OK, PGOOD, VPD, V20_OK, the rails) restarts or extends the window; only RESET (or a power-on reset) does

R3 no early arming: the window starts only at a genuine converter enable, i.e. U5 on through its own UVLO with valid status; the PD 5 V phase or an intermediate PDO cannot start it, so no threshold below the converter enable point can arm
R4 fail-safe: after ARMED any bad status > ~1 ms latches FAULT; FAULT holds RUN low until RESET; OV_N (U20 guard: +12V and -12V channels) presets FAULT at any time

topology.STARTED: U12 flip-flop A used as a set/reset latch: PRE_N = START_N, CLR_N = RESET_N, CLK = GND (no clock edges), D = V3V3, Q = STARTED (TP19)
topology.START_N: U14 gate 2: NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, RUN, V3V3, V3V3); low once U5 is on with PGOOD and FLT good, its status validated by V20_OK, while RUN. Level-sensitive, so a MAIN_OK that is already high at RESET release (PGOOD deglitch) still starts it; RUN in the gate keeps PRE_N high while RESET clears the latch
topology.TIMER_GO: U13 gate 3 = RUN AND STARTED -> R69/R70 -> U11 SENSE (unchanged divider)
topology.ARMED: U11 RESET output (R71 pull-up) = ARMED directly; it stays high because its input is latched
topology.ANY_BAD: U14 gate 1 = NAND(MAIN_LED_OK, P12_OK, N12_OK, V3V3): S9.0 ties the former P5_OK input high
topology.FAULT: U12 flip-flop B: CLK = ARMED AND BAD_FILTERED (U13 gate 2, R72/C51 + U15), PRE_N = OV_N, CLR_N = RESET_N; RUN = RESET_N AND NOT_FAULT (U5 SHDN; U2 EN = MAIN_OK; U4 via Q1)
topology.parts: no new IC: the spare U14 gate and U12 flip-flop A re-used; S9.0 R83 120k -> 100k (Basic, the 100k line of R2/R6/R14/R16/R17, no new code), TP19 (copper)

V20_OK.role: U5 status-validity floor: masks U5 FLT/PGOOD (MAIN_OK, R63 pull-up) where U5 is below its 4.5 V operating minimum (PD 5 V phase); NOT an input-good threshold
V20_OK.rule: band minimum >= vSafe5V max 5.5 V + 2.0 V and band maximum <= U5 turn-off minimum - 2.0 V
V20_OK.consequence: whenever U5 can be on (VPD >= its 11.37 V turn-off minimum) V20_OK is high, so MAIN_LED_OK = MAIN_OK there and V20_OK can never be the first status to drop; ANY_BAD = NOT(MAIN_LED_OK AND P12_OK AND N12_OK) means "U5 not on with valid status, or a rail below its monitor threshold"
V20_OK.history: S8.5 (20 V input): R83 120k, 9.06-10.96 V. At the 15 V input its maximum sits above the U5 turn-off minimum less 2 V, so S9.0 uses 100k. S8.4 200k / S8.3 220k tripped inside the U5 band (they meant neither "input good" nor "status valid")

arming.input_qualification: U5 UVLO through MAIN_OK (R2/R3 100k/10k): on 12.26-12.98 V (unloaded source: 15 V -5 % = 14.25 V, 1.27 V margin), off 11.37-12.19 V (loaded minimum 13.5 V, 1.31 V margin). Start-up needs an unloaded source >= the turn-on maximum: any compliant 15 V PDO

window.arming: S8.5: one-shot, see arming (TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED; S8.4 RUN AND MAIN_OK was restartable)

sequence: USB-C attach: VPD = vSafe5V; U9 makes V3V3; U10 holds RESET_N low >= 12 ms (clears STARTED, FAULT)
RESET_N high: RUN high (U5 SHDN released); U5 in UVLO, START_N high (V20_OK low in the 5 V phase)
PD contract: VPD -> 15 V; V20_OK high at 7.67-9.27 V (U5 status valid, PGOOD low)
VPD >= U5 turn-on (12.26-12.98 V): U5 ramps (dVdt, <= ~10 ms to 16.5 V), PGOOD 11.5 ms typ -> MAIN_OK enables U2 (EN/UVLO) (U4 follows +12V via Q1) -> MAIN_LED_OK -> START_N low -> STARTED (latched)
TIMER_GO = RUN AND STARTED -> U11 -> ARMED after 0.31-0.88 s; rails are up within ~81 ms
ARMED: any bad status (MAIN_LED_OK, P12_OK, N12_OK) > ~1 ms -> FAULT -> RUN low -> all off until RESET; OV_N (+12V > 14.48-15.27 V, -12V beyond 13.27-14.02 V) presets FAULT at any time
arming.timelines: validation.json startup_arming.timelines (verify_s8 arming_timelines: cold start at the worst loaded 15 V minimum, slow PD contract, brown-out after/inside the window, input overload chatter, hot plug into a live bus, load release, U20 guard before ARMED, short RESET), checked against R1-R4 from the native gate wiring; the S8.4 wiring fails them (test_s8 regression)

replug_por.corners: worst: R100 +2 % (1 % + 1 % TCR), C67 +10 % tolerance x +15 % X5R temperature (12.65 uF), V3V3 -2 %, R98/R99 0.1 % corners, LM2901B 5.5 mV offset and 50 nA bias; V3V3 rise time ignored (it only helps: REF_OV starts charging before the POR delay starts)
replug_por.S84_screen: S8.4 v3v3_loss: 8.2-10.7 ms, ~1 ms margin; it charged C67 from V3V3 through R100 alone and ignored the R98 current into the D22-clamped MON_OVN node. Withdrawn
replug_por.consequence: OV_N low at RESET release presets FAULT: MAIN stays off until RESET is pressed (fail-safe nuisance latch, no damage). Only when the -12V bus is held by something else at power-up (second supply, or a quick replug while the rack capacitance still holds -12V).
replug_por.status: OPEN: the margin is not established; candidate fixes (not implemented in S8.5): C67 4.7 uF (still right of the TLV431 instability region) roughly halves the settle time, or a CT capacitor on U10 lengthens the POR delay (both also change the RESET timing).

input_budget.note: planning estimate; efficiencies are assumptions. The per-rail ratings at once exceed the 3 A contract at the 13.5 V minimum, hence the published simultaneous total (rating.published_total_W)

connectors.guidance: typical 2.54 mm IDC/ribbon contact ~1 A: use both headers above ~2 A per rail; unequal cable lengths/loads do not split equally

reverse_current.decision: ACCEPTED architecture: no series reverse blocking (owner). S9.1 removes the self-enable defect in hardware; that defect is NOT an accepted event.
reverse_current.rule: No powered parallel supplies or unrestricted hotplug. Unpowered/latched-off injection is qualified ONLY under T1 conditions, not a procedural excuse for self-enabling.

plus12_path.power_stage: Disabled four-switch boost HS blocks bus-to-VIN power transfer; divider current/leakage and capacitor charging remain.

minus12_passive.fast_step_residual: D24 forward/internal diodes can clamp around -1.4V, outside U2 -0.3V minimum. D25 reduces it but is NOT guaranteed below 0.3V at high current/cold. Unrestricted hard hotplug remains UNQUALIFIED and is not a passing acceptance test.

minus12_active.finding: FIXED: Q1 emitter is own VPD; base sink requires RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK through Q14/Q15. R112 defaults off. Bus voltage alone cannot enable U4.
minus12_active.enabled_parallel_risk: FPWM still sinks if enabled against a higher external rail. -0.9A is TYPICAL only, not a worst-case bound; no finite-energy TVS can absorb an unlimited live bus.

enable_logic.logic: U4 enabled iff own VPD AND RUN AND MAIN_LED_OK (derived from the netlist, not assumed)
enable_logic.drive_source: Q1 emitter net VPD (own input upstream of D10); never +12V or VIN
enable_logic.equation: EN_N - V(-12V) = Q1 on ? (VPD - VCEsat - V(-12V))*R18/(R17+R18) : Ileak*R18
enable_logic.off_pullup: R112 ties Q1 base to VPD; R115 100k defines N_EN_RETURN; R18 pulls EN to the U4 ground
enable_logic.method: Structure traced from the design connectivity (LMR38020 EN pin -> divider -> PNP collector -> base pull-ups and series NMOS sink chain -> GND); bounds over VPD 12.26/16.5/19.44 V, resistor tolerance + TCR, NMOS VGS(th) 1.0-2.5 V with 1 uA leakage, PNP hFE >= 60, VEB <= 0.35 V off and 5 uA leakage. With a switch open the switches above it are source followers (node <= gate), so the chain current is bounded by the node defaults; a chain node with no DC default is undefined.
enable_logic.supply_loss_response: MAIN_OK has falling deglitch; until it drops a powered converter can sink a bus. Clamp test bounds that finite interval; never parallel a running module.

pulse_budget.basis: 1 A x VC 32.4 V (rated clamp bounds the 1 A clamp: 24.92 V at 25 C, 27.71 V at Tj 150 C via alphaVBR) x 20 ms = 0.648 J. Capability: 600 W 10/1000 us rating mapped to a 20 ms rectangle with a sqrt(t) thermal impedance (Dawson peak 0.541044) = 87.2 W at 25 C, x0.8 Fig. 2 derating at 50 C = 69.8 W. No universal joule rating or continuous claim; 5 W steady-state rating applies only on an infinite heat sink.

D24.protects: U2 VIN/SW1 42V abs /36V operating; 50V VIN bank and C25/C26 (32.4+14.02=46.4V); U5 OUT 67V; D25 30V at the 1 A budget (<=27.7V hot)
D24.coordination: U5 OVP 17.30-19.44 V opens the input before D24 conducts: OVP max < VR 20 V < VBR(0 C) 21.70 V
D24.limitations: Rated clamp is at 25C and specified waveform, not a measured PCB spike bound. Qualified fixture requires VIN<=30V incl ringing at 25/50C. Sustained enabled reverse power is NOT safe.

D25.scope: Bus slew <=1 V/s at 25C (<=26.5uA displacement current from 2x10u+100n rated high C). Not a cold/fast-hotplug clamp.

D26.protects: U2 VOUT/SW2/ISP/ISN 25V abs and local 25V MLCCs; not a 16V downstream guarantee
D26.limitations: Finite pulse backstop only; external rail source must be removed by fixture. No fuse coordination / crowbar or sustained shunt claim.

conditions: T1-A: no USB input, +/-12.0 and +/-12.6V external bus, 1A source limit, 0.44mF each rail; ramp <=1V/s at 25C, hold 10s; log EN_N relative to -12V, U4 SW, VIN and bus currents
T1-B: same with USB present and FAULT latched/RUN low; verify off-state once MAIN_OK deglitch expires and capture the preceding <=20ms interval
T1-C: only negative rail applied with same bounded slew; repeat rail order

T1-D: inject a positive 1A, <=20ms pulse into VIN at TP26 (compliance 33V, automatic disconnect), 25/50C, >=200s between pulses. This separately tests D24 energy/clamp; never assume the now-disabled U4 will generate this pulse
pass_criteria: T1-A/C: EN_N minus -12V <=0.11V settled (<=0.5V transient), zero U4 switching; VIN -0.3..1V after 100ms settled; each bus current <10mA after 100ms
T1-B: same EN/switching/current criteria after 20ms; VIN may retain own-input charge, must remain -0.3..30V, not climb from bus power
T1-D: VIN <=30V incl ringing at TP26, measured integral(V*I*dt)<=0.648J, clamp current ends by 20ms, no leakage increase >10uA after cooling; normal restart and regulation after RESET
All: automatic overvoltage disconnect at VIN 33V, negative excursion abort at -0.3V (fast comparator, not human reaction). An abort is a FAIL, not a pass.
bench_test.excluded: Hard hotplug, temperatures below25C for D25 forward-drop guarantee, >1A or >20ms sustained injection, and powered parallel supplies require new protection/qualification.

rail_overvoltage.decision: ACCEPTED architecture: no voltage-triggered fuse/crowbar; crowbar vs eFuse deferred/open. S9.1 D26 is a finite-energy transient backstop, not continuous shunt protection.
rail_overvoltage.response: U20 presets FAULT and opens U5; it does NOT disconnect an external rail source or immediately discharge stored energy.
why_no_fuse: A fuse responds to current, not voltage.
D24/D26 TVS pulse ratings do not authorize sustained reverse power.
rail_overvoltage.limitations: Energy screens are NOT guaranteed peaks. Internal U2 OVP 24.5V is never used as an ideal clamp. No-load output can exceed16V; -12V has no positive-magnitude clamp. Unrelated failed-short components and unlimited external supplies are excluded.

conditions: T2-A: input16.5V; 0.44mF +0.5A/rail; externally ramp +12V from12 to16.5V at<=1V/ms, <=1A, total injection<=10ms (including ramp), hold<=1ms at16.5V; fixture removes injection automatically after trigger; scope>=100MS/s
T2-B: R8 open at13.5/16.5V input, 3A source; no external C/no load, then0.44mF+0.5A; capture500ms with independent voltage/current abort
T2-C: R14 open, same conditions; no assumed LMR38020 output OVP
T2-D: RUN held low/logic powered, +14.0V and -13.0V external for10min; safely BELOW the minimum guard thresholds; no-trip only refers to OV_N, not RUN
T2-E: at+15.2V / -13.9V a trip is ALLOWED (inside tolerance bands); repeat guaranteed trip at+15.8V / -14.5V with <=1V/ms slew, <=1A source and >=50us hold (record actual waveform)
pass_criteria_this_module: With >=0.5V rail overdrive beyond each measured trip, OV_N low/FAULT set/RUN low <=20us; MAIN LED off. Keep FAULT latched10s after injection removed, reset explicitly only after fault repair

Externally driven rail remains externally driven until fixture removal: NEVER require it off while injection remains. After removal connect1k/1W discharge load; both rails below1V within2s at <=0.44mF external C

T2-B/C: observed positive rail peak<=24.0V and negative magnitude<=24.0V for the500ms capture; positive duration above16V<=100ms with specified1k discharge; D26 pulse energy<=0.10J; normal regulation after repair/RESET

T2-D OV_N stays high. T2-E band points may trip or not; above-band points MUST trip. Automatic abort at+24V / -24V / VIN33V, source removed in<=2us; any abort fails qualification, no human-only protection
downstream_qualification: Without a separate rail protector, downstream modules must tolerate16.5V/10s and sub-threshold +15.3V/-14.1V continuously, and up to24V magnitude/100ms or their measured actual exposure if worse. Ordinary16V caps are NOT thereby qualified; incompatible modules excluded until crowbar/eFuse decision.
